title: Prevalence and factors associated with chhaupadi in Nepal: Evidence from Nepal Multiple Indicator Cluster Survey (NMICS) 2019
core_idea: To assess the prevalence of the harmful menstrual exile practice chhaupadi and identify its sociodemographic determinants in Sudurpaschim province, Nepal, using data from the NMICS 2019 and statistical analyses (chi-square, bivariate, and multivariable logistic regression).
tldr: This study uses NMICS 2019 data to investigate how common chhaupadi is in Sudurpaschim province and which sociodemographic factors are associated with its practice, employing chi-square tests and logistic regression analyses.
